title: IMD predicts below-normal rainfall over India in September

Strong El Niño conditions are expected to persist, negatively affecting monsoon rainfall patterns. Neutral Indian Ocean Dipole conditions will not benefit the monsoon this year.

title: US PrSM missiles in Iran strike killed civilians up to 50 metres away: Report
description: On February 28, a series of strikes in Lamerd, Iran, resulted in the tragic loss of at least twenty-one civilians. It is believed that US-manufactured Precision Strike Missiles facilitated the deadly attack, as these weaponry disperse dense tungsten pellets rapidly in various directions. While the US military has confirmed the use of PrSMs in Iranian operations on that date, they have disavowed any specific targeting of Lamerd.

title: Why is it illegal to take sand from some beaches? Reasons you should know
description: Removing sand from beaches carries hefty penalties due to its dire environmental consequences. Destinations like Sardinia and Hawaii impose stringent laws against the extraction of sand, pebbles, or shells, as these elements play a crucial role in combating coastal erosion and nurturing marine life. In India, rampant illegal sand mining devastates neighborhoods and ecosystems alike, exhausting this precious resource and igniting lasting repercussions.

title: India’s GPS problem: Why the armed forces need NavIC to work
description: India's NavIC satellite system, crucial for military and civilian use, currently has only three operational satellites. This shortfall impacts its ability to provide accurate positioning and navigation services. The system's reliability issues stemmed from imported atomic clocks, now being replaced by indigenous ones. Upcoming launches aim to restore the full constellation's functionality. This indigenous capability is vital for India's strategic autonomy and modernization efforts.
